title: Fail a release only on real differences in a replayed response

cases.says: a replayed response that differs only in the fields that change every run has no differences, built or unpacked
a changed, a missing and an added field are each reported once by number
binary values are equal when their bytes are equal, even in two different arrays
sub-fields are compared one by one and reported by their dotted path, a sub-field that changes every run is left out, and a nested field missing on one side is reported sub-field by sub-field
the bitmap an unpacked response keeps is not a difference, so a missing field is reported once
differences come in ascending field order, including fields only the replayed response carries

origin.section: 17.3 Two Messages Are Compared Field by Field, and Binary Fields by Content
